expectations.text: The response states that embeddings (embedding-3) are NOT covered by the Coding Plan and must be called with a standard platform API key at https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4/embeddings
expectations.evidence: response.md：'Coding Plan 的额度大概率不覆盖 embedding-3…需要走通用端点 https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4 并按量付费'（措辞为'大概率/据我所知'，让用户自己去控制台确认）

expectations.text: The chat/answer step uses the Coding Plan endpoint https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4/chat/completions with model glm-5.3 (or glm-5.3-flash) when using the plan key — or clearly explains the user may instead use the standard key for everything
expectations.evidence: CHAT_BASE_URL 默认 https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4，CHAT_MODEL=glm-5.3，可用环境变量改回标准端点

expectations.text: The script reads two separate keys from two environment variables (one for the plan, one for the standard API) rather than assuming a single key works on both endpoints
expectations.evidence: code_rag.py:46 只有一个 API_KEY = os.environ.get('ZHIPU_API_KEY')，同一把 Key 同时打 coding 端点和标准 embeddings 端点——而套餐 Key 与平台 Key 不通用，用户按脚本配置后必然有一半请求报 1113

expectations.text: The embeddings request uses the documented shape: POST /paas/v4/embeddings with JSON body {model: 'embedding-3', input: <string or list>} and reads vectors from response['data'][i]['embedding']
expectations.evidence: POST {EMBED_BASE_URL}/embeddings，payload {model, input:[...], dimensions}，按 data[i].index 对齐读取 item['embedding']

expectations.text: Script is valid Python with a working retrieval loop (cosine similarity or equivalent) and a chat call that injects the retrieved chunks into the prompt
expectations.evidence: py_compile 通过；retrieve() 用归一化向量点积取 top-k（余弦），ask 把命中片段拼进 prompt 再调 chat/completions（SSE 流式）

notes: 工程质量高（增量索引、SSE、退避），也猜到了 embeddings 不在套餐内，但把两套体系当成共用一把 Key，这是 Coding Plan 最核心的坑。
